source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 多地小学老师转教初中
topics.official_english: Primary school teachers in many regions shift to junior high teaching posts
topics.why_hot: The topic affects teachers, parents and students alike, and it raises questions about staffing changes across school levels.
topics.share_angle: Explain the reported trend and what it may mean for teacher training, certification and school management.

topics.official_english: Pocket air conditioners become a sales hit
topics.why_hot: A small cooling gadget has caught the public's imagination as concerns about heat and everyday comfort grow.
topics.share_angle: Look at how the pocket-size product became a viral item and what consumers consider before buying it.

topics.chinese_topic: “打疫苗破坏自身免疫系统”系误区
topics.official_english: Misconception clarified: Vaccination does not undermine the immune system
topics.why_hot: Public concern about vaccine safety is common, and a clear correction quickly becomes a widely shared topic.
topics.share_angle: Use the clarification to explain why this myth persists and how vaccines interact with the immune system.

topics.chinese_topic: 为继承母亲手机号 姐弟三人打官司
topics.official_english: Three siblings go to court over inheritance of mother's mobile phone number
topics.why_hot: The dispute highlights how personal digital assets such as mobile numbers are handled, which many families can relate to.
topics.share_angle: Use this case to discuss the legal and emotional value of mobile numbers and digital accounts after a family member dies.

topics.chinese_topic: 人教版语文教材新增这篇课文
topics.official_english: New lesson added to People's Education Press Chinese-language textbook
topics.why_hot: Textbook changes draw attention because they show what kind of content students will be exposed to in class.
topics.share_angle: Look at public reactions to curriculum choices and what they say about the direction of Chinese-language education.

topics.chinese_topic: 李月汝因遗失护照落选女篮大名单
topics.official_english: Basketball player Li Yueru misses national team roster after losing passport
topics.why_hot: The surprising reason behind a sports roster decision makes people pay attention to what players deal with off the court.
topics.share_angle: Tell the sports news factually and discuss the logistical and preparation challenges facing team athletes.

topics.official_english: Will housing prices rise? Debate grows over market expectations
topics.why_hot: Housing affects household savings, borrowing and life plans, so any question about price direction draws broad attention.
topics.share_angle: Summarize the discussion and explain what factors are commonly watched when people assess where housing prices may go.

topics.chinese_topic: .9元卖爆 “中国版乐高”能跑多远
topics.official_english: Budget 'Chinese LEGO' toy blocks sell big; can the momentum last?
topics.why_hot: The success of cheap domestic building-block toys raises wider questions about local brands and price-led consumption.
topics.share_angle: Analyze why low-priced toy kits are attracting buyers and the challenges brands face beyond a burst of discounts.
